description.zh: 查询时间区间的开始时间，该时间不得早于频道实际的创建时间，不得早于30天之前。使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。
description.en: Start Time of the query time range. This time must not be earlier than the actual Creation Time of the channel and must not be more than 30 days ago. It is represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

description.zh:
查询时间区间的结束时间，该时间不得晚于频道释放时间。使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。参数为空，表示获取当前时间。

> 如果传入的结束时间超过频道的释放时间，将返回从开始时间开始到频道释放时间之间的数据，且最多返回最近3个小时的数据。
description.en:
End Time of the query time range. This time must not be later than the channel release time. It is represented as a UNIX timestamp, in seconds. If the parameter is empty, the current time is used.

> If the provided End Time exceeds the channel release time, data from the Start Time to the channel release time will be returned, with a maximum duration of the most recent 3 hours.

description.zh: 指标枚举列表，多个用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: Enumeration list of Metrics, separated by commas (,).

description.zh:
发布端用户通信流的Call ID，多个用英文逗号（,）分隔。
> PubUserId和PubCallIdList参数只能二选一输入。
description.en:
Call IDs of the publisher's communication streams, separated by English commas (,).  
> You must specify either PubUserId or PubCallIdList, but not both.

description.zh:
发布端用户ID。
> PubUserId和PubCallIdList参数只能二选一输入。
description.en:
User ID of the publisher.  
> You can specify either the PubUserId parameter or the PubCallIdList parameter, but not both.

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
本接口用于获取端对端指标数据。例如：您可以获取订阅端和发布端的指标信息。
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### How-To  
This API is used to obtain end-to-end metric data. For example, you can retrieve metric information from both the subscriber side and the publisher side.  

### QPS Limit  
The queries per second (QPS) limit for this API is 10 requests per second per user. If this limit is exceeded, API calls will be subject to Rate Limiting, which may impact your business. Please invoke the API appropriately.
